text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Manchester City and Chelsea at the Etihad Stadium!
After Liverpool and Arsenal both won earlier today, City are looking to keep pace by closing the gap to the top with another win to extend their impressive unbeaten run here.

After a slight blip in November - in a run that included a thrilling 4-4 draw with Chelsea at Stamford Bridge - the Citizens are currently on a run of 14 without defeat in all competitions (W13 D1), having won each of their last 11 on the bounce.
They extended that streak with a commanding performance in a 3-1 win over Copenhagen in the first leg of their Champions League last 16 tie on Tuesday.
As for Chelsea, it's been a rollercoaster of a season for them so far which sees them sitting in mid-table, but things look to be on the upturn once more.

After suffering back-to-back defeats against Liverpool and Wolves in which they conceded four goals in both, they've won their last two games 3-1 against Aston Villa in the FA Cup fourth-round replay and Crystal Palace in the league on Monday.
However, they don't have the best record away at City, winning just two of their last eight trips to the Etihad (L6).
Pep Guardiola makes three changes to the side that beat Copenhagen in midweek, with Akanji, Alvarez and Doku all being brought into the side.
Stones and Silva, who went off with an ankle problem in that game, drop to the bench.
Kovacic and Gomez are also among the substitutes after passing late fitness checks, but Jack Grealish is out with a muscle injury.
Mauricio Pochettino makes just two changes from their comeback win over Palace last time out.
Sterling comes in to face his former club, while Colwill replaces the injured Thiago Silva, who is out after picking up a groin problem in that game.
Madueke starts on the bench.
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Fernandez gets the game under way for Chelsea!
CHANCE! City are out of the blocks quickly, but when De Bruyne squares it to Haaland, the forward can't bring it under control.

source.label: assist
source.text: De Bruyne squares it to Haaland

text: It rolls back to Alvarez, who runs onto it and hits the shot first time, but he drills it wide of the far post.
City are keeping possession well in their own half, and stay calm as they work it around Chelsea's high press.
Gallagher tries to force Rodri into a mistake, but the Spaniard simply sweeps it out to Walker on the right.
The hosts finally find some space through the middle as Haaland drops deep to help it onto De Bruyne, and he spots Foden in space down the right.
Chelsea quickly double up on the Englishman though, and he can't find space for a shot.
It's lovely play from Chelsea as Palmer picks out Fernandez on the edge of the box, and he slides it through for Gallagher.
He pulls it back into the space in the middle of the penalty area, but it's behind Jackson, who had made a good run.
SAVE! Foden's free-kick is cleared by Caicedo, but only as far as Rodri, who puts his laces through it on the half-volley.
Colwill gets in the way of that, but Petrovic misses the punch.
Luckily for the goalkeeper, he's in the right place to hold Dias' tame header.
WIDE! Chelsea just switch off as City work it down their left, and it's a wonderful cross from Alvarez to pick out Haaland in the middle.
He rises high to meet it, but glances his effort wide of the far post.
SAVE! Chelsea go for a more direct route this time, with Caicedo lifting it over the top for Sterling, who makes a lovely weaving run inside from the left.
He goes it alone, curling a low shot on goal, but Ederson easily holds onto it.
City haven't lost any of their last 22 Premier League games at the Etihad (W18 D4), with only Liverpool on a longer unbeaten run at home (24).
The Citizens are also on the longest scoring run on home soil in the competition, scoring in their last 44 matches in a row (135 goals).
Ake races back to stop Palmer from getting away down the left, but when he knocks it back to Ederson, the goalkeeper hesitates.
Jackson rushes over to pick his pocket but then plays a poor cross into the box, where no Chelsea players are waiting.
Ake slides in to stop Palmer from getting a shot away, and Chelsea win a corner which comes to nothing.
Sterling keeps it alive after Dias clears it, but the visitors are struggling to impose themselves in the box.
Ake intercepts another attempted Chelsea attack and sets off on the counter, racing down the left.
He runs into Gusto before he can put a cross away, and goes down cheaply, but doesn't get the free-kick he's looking for.
GREAT SAVE! City are caught out by another direct attack, with Palmer sweeping it out to Gusto on the right.
He's being closed down by Dias but curls a wonderful early cross to Jackson, who can't get it out of his feet.
When he does, Ederson is already there to smother it.
Disasi rises above Akanji to head away City's corner, but he catches Akanji in the side of the head with his arm.
The Swiss defender needs a moment before getting back to his feet, but he doesn't need treatment.
There are big shouts from the home fans, led by Haaland, for a penalty after the forward goes down in the box.
He was in a tussle with Chilwell during a corner, but no spot-kick is given.
After catching City out with their more direct approach a few times already, Disasi tries his luck again, lifting it over the top for Jackson.
The forward isn't on the same wavelength this time though, and Akanji sees it back to Ederson.
Doku is still finding a lot of space down the left, and he gets a yard on Palmer this time to swing a cross into the box.
None of his team-mates have made a far-post run though, and Chilwell is able to clear the danger.
It's Sterling who manages to beat the offside trap this time as Fernandez plays him in behind, but the winger can't sort his feet out quickly enough.
Ederson rushes off his line and intercepts just inside his box.
Caicedo is the wrong side of De Bruyne when he tries to cut him off, and he takes out the Belgian's standing leg.
He's protesting his innocence, but that was always going to be a booking.
Gallagher is down holding his foot, and Walker knocks the ball out of play so he can be seen to, much to the City fans' frustration.
Their mood doesn't improve as the midfielder gets back up without needing treatment.
City are keeping Chelsea penned back in their own half, but haven't been able to get it into the box.
Foden has acres of space ahead of him down the right, but doesn't react quick enough when Akanji threads it forward for him to chase.
The ball loops over Alvarez's shoulder and he hits the shot on the volley, but it's blocked in front of him by Disasi.
There are optimistic shouts of handball from the crowd, but it was never going to be given.
STERLING SCORES! Chelsea break quickly on the counter-attack after smothering City's latest attack, and Gusto slides it down the right for Jackson.
He stays onside and squares it to Sterling, who cuts inside to leave Akanji on the floor before curling his shot around Ederson and into the far bottom corner.

events.action: curling his shot around Ederson and into the far bottom corner

text: 1-0 Chelsea!
Jackson does brilliantly to time his run, and to get his head up and spot Sterling getting forward in support on the opposite flank.
This time, Foden squares up against Sterling instead, and he uses the winger as a shield to curl a dangerous cross into the far post.
Haaland is waiting to attack it, but Disasi makes a vital interception just in front of him.
Into the first of at least three added minutes here, and there's more intensity to City's play.
Doku links up well with Rodri down the left before the Spaniard tees up Alvarez, but his first-time shot is deflected wide of the far post.
CHANCE! Ake whips a lovely cross into the middle of the box for Haaland, and he does well to get in front of Akanji at the last moment to meet it.
He can't direct his header on target though, and it bounces just wide.
HALF-TIME: MANCHESTER CITY 0-1 CHELSEA.
Sterling's goal separates the sides at the break as Chelsea lead 1-0.

The visitors didn't create too many chances, but they were all clear-cut, with Ederson having to deny Sterling and Jackson before the deadlock was broken - the Blues broke quickly on the counter, with Jackson setting up the ex-City man to curl his shot into the bottom corner.

events.action: curl his shot into the bottom corner

text: City have had opportunities of their own, with Haaland and Alvarez both coming close on a couple of occasions, but they couldn't beat Petrovic.
Guardiola was visibly displeased when his side conceded and with good reason after some of the chances his team failed to take.
He'll want to see a big improvement in front of goal as they look to get what would be a vital three points in the title race.
Chelsea have looked organised and taken advantage when they have been able to get forward - Pochettino will be asking for more of the same after the break.
City get us back under way for the second half!
CLOSE! Rodri is tripped just outside the box by Caicedo, and City have a free-kick in a dangerous position.
De Bruyne steps up, whipping his shot over the wall towards the far-top corner, but it lands on the roof of the net.
Walker is down in the box and there are obviously shouts for a penalty, but the referee gives a foul against the right-back.
He stepped across Sterling, who tripped over his leg, and the free-kick goes Chelsea's way.
GREAT CHANCE! City break quickly on the counter, with De Bruyne sliding it out to Foden on the right.
He squares a brilliant cross into the middle, but Haaland can't wrap his foot around it and ends up slicing it wide of the far post.
Chelsea have won all 16 of the previous Premier League games in which they've led City at half-time.
City's frustration continues to grow the longer that they're off the ball, and when Gallagher threatens to burst through the middle again, he's tripped.
The visitors look a threat every time they go forward.
DOUBLE SAVE! Chilwell clips a good cross in from the left, and it's Walker who gets the telling touch as he turns it towards goal, but Ederson is in the right place to block it.
It rolls back out to the left-back, who fizzes it in this time, and the goalkeeper's touch helps it to Dias, who clears it on the line.
Gusto is tracking Doku all the way, but the Belgian drops a shoulder to get a yard on his defender before pulling it back into the middle.
He's looking for Haaland in the middle, but it's just behind him.
Palmer cuts off Ake as the defender tries to turn on the halfway line, and gets a yellow card for it.
CHANCE! Doku clips another good cross in from the left, and Foden watches it all the way so he can meet it with an overhead kick.
It's never heading on target though, and Colwill clears it at the far post.
Petrovic is already taking his time over his goal-kicks, and he's booked for time-wasting.
There are changes for both sides here, starting with Chelsea.
The goalscorer, Sterling, is taken off, with Nkunku on in his place.
And for City, it's Alvarez that's making way for Silva.
GOOD SAVE! Doku has drifted infield, and he just touches it forward as Haaland races past him into the box.
He takes it in stride before firing a shot at the near post, but Petrovic pushes it wide.
It's end-to-end at the moment as Chelsea break on a counter-attack of their own, and Gallagher picks out Jackson in space on the left of the box.
He can't keep his shot down though, blazing it over the crossbar.
Another City corner is cleared by the first man, but De Bruyne brings it down to keep it alive.
He attempts to spread it out wide once more, but neither Doku or Foden are offering themselves as options on their respective wing.
Chelsea second change sees the other former City player, Palmer, slowly make his way off the field.
Pochettino is bolstering his defence by bringing on Chalobah.
Chelsea aren't committing as many bodies forward in attack, but they're still causing City problems when they do get forward.
Chilwell goes for the big switch out to Gusto, but he leaves the ball behind when he tries to cut inside.
De Bruyne is looking to play a one-two with Foden, but he drops dramatically to the floor after slight contact from Caicedo before he can get to the return pass.
He's expecting a free-kick, but the referee waves play on.
Foden's cross is overhit, but Haaland blocks Colwill's run so that it will reach Silva on the far side.
He floats an inviting cross back into the box, but none of his team-mates try to attack it.
CHANCE! Haaland misses another one! It's a marvellous cross from De Bruyne on the left and Haaland peels away from his defender to get on the end of it.
He thumps a header on goal, but it sails over the bar.
It's not been his day so far!
WIDE! City's corner count continues to tick up, but Chilwell steps in front of Haaland to flick the delivery away from him.
It falls to Silva's feet on the edge of the box, and his whipped shot flies just wide of the far post.
Chelsea's final change sees Casadei brought on in place of Jackson.
RODRI EQUALISES! It's been coming for City! Silva chips a cross out to Walker on the right of the box, and he meets it on the volley, putting his laces through the shot.
Colwill blocks it, but the ball falls straight to Rodri's feet, and he pokes it back towards goal.
Petrovic looked to have it covered, but a deflection off Disasi's thigh took it over the keeper and into the roof of the net.
Silva's first touch is heavy, and in an attempt to make up for it, he slides in on Caicedo, catching him on the ankle.
He's the first City player to go into the referee's book.
It's all City at the moment as they search for a late winner, and it's spread out to Doku on the left once more.
Chelsea are doubling up on him though, giving him no space to work in.
Gallagher makes an interception in midfield, but Chelsea are in no hurry to get upfield.
Fernandez holds onto it for as long as he can before attempting to pick out Chilwell, but he's strayed well offside by the time the ball gets to him.
SAVE! We're into the first of four added minutes here, and Chelsea break quickly on the counter.
Chilwell clips it into the box for Nkunku, who attempts an awkward-looking bicycle kick, but it's straight at Ederson.
OVER! Fernandez is upended just outside his own box, but the referee waves play on as City pick up the ball.
Silva lays it off to Walker, who tries his luck from range again, but it sails just over the bar.
With seconds left on the clock, the City players are screaming for a penalty after it pinballed through the box.
The ball seemed to bounce up against Colwill's arm, but the referee says no to the claims.
BLOCK! City carry on pushing, and in the chaos, Rodri takes aim from range.
His shot flies through the crowded box, hitting Disasi in the midriff, and the Chelsea players can only watch as it bounces wide of the far post.
FULL-TIME: MANCHESTER CITY 1-1 CHELSEA.
City come from behind in the second half to earn a 1-1 draw with Chelsea.
The Citizens dominated for most of the match but found themselves behind at the break thanks to their former player, Sterling.
Chelsea broke quickly on the counter, with the winger curling his low shot into the bottom corner to break the deadlock.

events.action: curling his low shot into the bottom corner

text: City pushed, and for a long time, it looked like it wasn't going to be their day, with Haaland in particular squandering some good chances.
Rodri eventually found a way through, latching onto Walker's blocked shot, and his shot deflected in off Disasi.
No matter how much pressure they piled on though, they couldn't find the late winner they were searching for.
That point means that City stay in third, four points behind Liverpool and two below Arsenal.
Next up for them is their game in hand against Brentford.
There's no movement for Chelsea either in 10th, and they're next match is the EFL Cup final against Liverpool next weekend.
That's all for today, goodbye!
